published_papers.title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
published_papers.review_scope: Reviewed the complete 28-page paper, experimental setup, preregistered and held-out splits, simulator mismatch, scoring, effort ablation, token tradeoffs and limitations.

review_note: Enabled arXiv, Hugging Face daily-paper and research indexes were inspected before selection. One within-72-hour original paper was admitted after complete methods, results and limitations review.
